name: task_wait
description: Wait for one or more asynchronously spawned subagent tasks (from task_spawn) to complete and collect their results. Polls all tasks in parallel, so total wait equals the slowest task. Parked and budget-elapsed responses include the pending tasks' latest live progress/checkpoint snapshots. `timeout_secs` is a per-call budget: on expiry it returns collected results plus a note that the rest are still running; call again with the same task_ids (or `wait_policy="any"` to wake on the first finisher).

task_ids.description: Array of task_id strings returned by task_spawn.

timeout_secs.description: Wait budget for THIS call (clamped to [1, 60], default 30). Suspends the parent, so call only after independent work is exhausted. Hitting the budget does NOT cancel or stall the subagent; it keeps running — use task_status while other work remains.

wait_policy.description: Optional. 'any' (default) returns on the first finisher so the parent resumes promptly; 'all' waits until every pending task finishes. Remaining tasks stay alive and can be retrieved later.
